files.note: Departamento de la Vivienda, "Refugios Temporada de Huracanes 2026" (PDF, 19 pages, text via pdftotext -layout). Columns in the document: municipio, facility, address, Google Maps link; it gives no capacities, so capacity is absent. 343 shelters. facility_type is read from the name's first words (Esc. = school, Centro Comunal = community centre, ...). Coordinates, where present (332 of 343), come from the Google Maps link printed in the list: the short link is followed and the coordinates are read from the resolved URL; a point more than 25 km from the municipio's internal point is discarded. Shelters not located this way have no coordinates (location_basis "not located"). No matching to OpenStreetMap facilities has been done yet, so there are no housed_at links. municipio.shelters = shelters listed per municipio.
